The search turned up community GGUF builds of TAIDE models for Ollama, plus background on the TAIDE project itself.

- **Ollama-ready GGUF (Llama 3 base):** A Hugging Face repo by UOfficeForceX offers a GGUF conversion of the TAIDE Llama-3 Traditional Chinese model. The uploader says the conversion was made without further fine-tuning and that the file runs in Ollama (這是完全基於 TAIDE Llama-3 繁體中文模型 ... 未經任何微調的情境下所轉出的GGUF格式檔,可運行於Ollama工具). This is a third-party conversion, not an official release.
- **Llama3-TAIDE-LX-8B-Chat-Alpha1 (quantized):** QuantFactory hosts a llama.cpp quantization of this 8B chat model in GGUF format. The TAIDE Llama 3 series is based on Meta's released LLaMA3-8b model, incorporating text and training materials from various fields in Taiwan.
- **Original TAIDE-LX-7B (Llama 2 base):** The National Science and Technology Council released this 7B model in April 2024. It is built on Llama-2-7B with extra Traditional Chinese characters and words added to its vocabulary (per the iThome report). Training data includes 新聞、立法院公報、光華雜誌、今週刊、教育部國語辭典-type sources, according to a KOC article that also describes running it in LM Studio.
- **Project background:** A Ministry of Economic Affairs slide deck describes TAIDE as 針對繁體中文、台灣用語、台灣知識、台灣文化、台灣價值進行訓練優化的大型語言模型. The same deck lists larger models (70B, 8x22B) as still in development, so those may not be publicly available yet.

Caveat: these results are mostly from 2024 and earlier. I didn't confirm which GGUF builds are currently available on Ollama's own library, so check the Ollama model list and the TAIDE Hugging Face page (huggingface.co/taide) for the latest releases.

Web search results for query: "Ollama Qwen3 model sizes 8b 4b library"

Links: [{"title":"github.com","url":"https://github.com/cedrickchee/Qwen3"},{"title":"github.com","url":"https://github.com/coderonion/Qwen3"},{"title":"Join our Discord Server","url":"https://collabnix.com/qwen-3-the-game-changing-ai-model-thats-revolutionizing-local-ai-development/"},{"title":"Qwen3 Embedding & Reranker Models on Ollama: State-of-the-Art Performance","url":"https://glukhov.org/post/2025/06/qwen3-embedding-qwen3-reranker-on-ollama"},{"title":"AI prompts","url":"https://trendshift.io/admin/repository/ask-ai/11786"},{"title":"run qwen3 locally gpu requirements 2026","url":"https://www.spheron.network/blog/run-qwen3-locally-gpu-requirements-2026/"},{"title":"ollama qwen","url":"https://www.agenticwire.news/article/ollama-qwen"}]

The search turned up consistent evidence that the official Ollama library has Qwen3 tags at 4B and 8B, with a few caveats.

- **Official tags:** One guide notes that Ollama's Qwen3 tags download pre-quantized GGUF Q4_K_M files by default, and gives the download size as about 2.5 GB for the 4B tag and about 5.2 GB for the 8B tag (ollama pull qwen3:4b ~2.5 GB; ollama pull qwen3:8b ~5.2 GB). A second page, which appears to be a 2026 Ollama library review, lists the same 5.2 GB size for qwen3:8b and says the qwen3 family runs from 0.6b to 235b (qwen3 | qwen3:8b | 5.2GB | 40K | tools, thinking).
- **Context length:** That same review says the 4b, 30b and 235b tags default to a 256K context window, while 8b defaults to 40K (4b, 30b, 235b default to 256K).
- **Usage:** Community docs show the pull and run commands as ollama run qwen3:8b, with other size suffixes such as :30b-a3b.
- **Architecture:** The official Qwen3 release includes dense models at 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B and 32B, plus MoE models at 30B-A3B and 235B-A22B (dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models of various sizes, available in 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, 32B and 30B-A3B, 235B-A22B).
- **Embedding and reranker variants:** These are not in the official qwen3 tags. They are community uploads under the dengcao namespace in 0.6B, 4B and 8B sizes (for example, dengcao/Qwen3-Embedding-8B).

Caveats: the download sizes come from third-party blogs, not the Ollama tags pages directly, so they may be slightly off and could have changed. The 2026 review also mentions newer releases (qwen3.5, qwen3.6, qwen3.8) that I could not verify, so I would not rely on that page for anything beyond the qwen3 tags.

content.text:
## 主要推薦：Ollama + Qwen3 8B

Qwen3 8B 是目前最適合你這台機器的選擇。它的中文能力好，Ollama 官方就有提供，而且 Q4 量化版約 5.2 GB，在 16GB 統一記憶體上跑得動，還能留給其他程式。Ollama 免費、免註冊，在終端機用 `ollama run` 就能對話，模型下載完之後可以完全離線使用。

**需要注意的是**：Qwen3 的預設重心不是繁體中文，偶爾會冒出簡體字。所以下面的步驟會用 system prompt 把它固定在繁體與台灣用語。這是提示詞的約束，無法保證 100% 不出現簡體字，遇到時可以直接再要求它改寫。

### 安裝步驟

1. 安裝 Ollama（二選一）：
   - 到 ollama.com/download 下載 macOS 版並安裝，或
   - 若已有 Homebrew：`brew install ollama`
2. 確認安裝成功：`ollama --version`

### 第一次執行

1. 下載模型（需要網路，約 5.2 GB）：
   ```
   ollama pull qwen3:8b
   ```
2. 建立一個固定繁體與台灣用語的版本。在任意資料夾建立名為 `Modelfile` 的文字檔，內容如下：
   ```
   FROM qwen3:8b
   SYSTEM """你是一位使用台灣繁體中文的助理。請一律使用繁體中文與台灣用語（例如：軟體、資料、網路、影片、計程車、品質），不要使用簡體字。"""
   ```
3. 建立並執行：
   ```
   ollama create tw-qwen3 -f Modelfile
   ollama run tw-qwen3
   ```
4. 進入對話後直接輸入問題。輸入 `/bye` 離開。

### 可選調整

- Qwen3 預設會先輸出思考過程，回答較慢。若想直接看答案，可在對話中輸入 `/set nothink`。
- 若記憶體吃緊，可改用 `qwen3:4b`（約 2.5 GB），回答品質會下降一些。

## 備選：TAIDE（台灣本土模型）

如果你特別在意台灣用語與知識，可以試國科會 TAIDE 計畫的 Llama 3 8B。它是為繁體中文與台灣用語訓練的，但 Ollama 官方庫目前沒有直接提供，要從 Hugging Face 下載第三方轉出的 GGUF 檔，再用 `FROM ./檔名.gguf` 的 Modelfile 匯入。這個做法比較麻煩，而且模型基於 2024 年的版本，較舊。來源可參考 [QuantFactory 的 GGUF 版本](https://huggingface.co/QuantFactory/Llama3-TAIDE-LX-8B-Chat-Alpha1-GGUF) 與 [TAIDE-Llama3 的說明頁](https://huggingface.co/UOfficeForceX/TAIDE-Llama3)。建議先用 Qwen3 上手，覺得台灣用語不夠道地再來試 TAIDE。

## 假設與限制

- 我假設你要的是「能在終端機對話、免費、免帳號」的方案，並沒有實際在你的機器上執行任何指令。
- 模型大小與版本來自網路搜尋的第三方資料，實際下載大小與可用標籤請以 Ollama 官方模型頁為準。
- 我沒有實際測試 Qwen3 在繁體輸出上的表現，建議安裝後先問幾個台灣常用詞（例如「影片」「軟體」「計程車」）確認效果。

Sources:
- [QuantFactory/Llama3-TAIDE-LX-8B-Chat-Alpha1-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/QuantFactory/Llama3-TAIDE-LX-8B-Chat-Alpha1-GGUF)
- [UOfficeForceX/TAIDE-Llama3](https://huggingface.co/UOfficeForceX/TAIDE-Llama3)
- [Qwen3 on Ollama: sizes and tags (glukhov.org / agenticwire.news summaries)](https://glukhov.org/post/2025/06/qwen3-embedding-qwen3-reranker-on-ollama)
